note: Rewritten from the original species-level description by Haviland (1898), the original in English; it includes the imago, queen, soldier and worker, and the measurements are in mm. The original gives "Hab. Borneo (Sarawak). Type, No. 377". The species is the type species of the "Termes nemorosus group" established by Haviland, now placed in Dicuspiditermes.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body length 6 mm, dark blackish brown above, the mesonotal and metanotal sclerites and the venter dark brown. Head oval; ocelli about one diameter away from the compound eyes; fenestra indistinct; antennae 14 or 15-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2; clypeus not projecting. Anterior margin of the pronotum straight, the anterolateral corners pointed and slightly curved down, the posterior margin indistinctly bilobed; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum narrow and rather sharply lobed; forewing buds slightly larger than the hindwing buds; hind legs hardly reaching the apex of the abdomen; abdominal protuberances absent. In the female the sternite of abdominal segment 7 is less than half as long as wide, its posterior margin rounded; the queen's abdomen reaches a body length of 22 mm, distinctly swollen, the lateral abdominal cuticle with pigment dots.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 5 mm; head pale yellowish white, 3 mm long and 1 mm wide. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal. Labrum soft, white, 0.5 mm long, asymmetrical, slightly lobed, the apex of each lobe with a soft seta. Mandibles 1.5 mm long, shaped as in speciosus: linear, strongly curved, the right mandible shorter and straight, the left mandible with its basal third directed inwards, its middle third abruptly turned outwards and its apical third directed forwards again. Postmentum constricted at the basal third, widening evenly over the apical two-thirds. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior part raised. Hind femora reaching the apex of the abdomen; abdominal protuberances absent; abdomen oval, white.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 4 mm; head pale yellowish white; antennae 14-segmented; thorax narrow; abdomen long-oval, wider than the head, dark owing to the intestinal contents.
